name: Atlas Readiness Gate & Zero Unloaded Frames

baseline_v11.issue: Cold-start captures triggered console warnings: 'Missing or unloaded atlas frame for ..., vector fallback disabled' due to asynchronous WebP texture decoding while first canvas frames were being rendered.

atlasLoader.isFrameLoading: Added helper to track in-flight texture page fetches
atlasLoader.isCoreReady: Added helper checking indexLoaded and zero pending page loading promises
atlasLoader.preloadCoreAtlases: Explicitly awaits all core, settlement, water, nature, and UI pages

proceduralObjects.skipInFlight: Frames whose texture pages are currently in flight skip rendering cleanly instead of triggering missing warnings or drawing fallback artifacts
proceduralObjects.warnPolicy: Strictly warn ONLY when atlas index is loaded AND frame defId is genuinely absent from spriteRegistry

worldCanvas.atlasReadyWindowFlag: Exposed window.atlasReady on window object, initialized false and set true once textures are resident
worldCanvas.renderLoopReadiness: Verifies visObjs.every(o => atlasLoader.isSpriteReady(o.defId)) before firing __chunksReady and atlasReady

captureWorld.waitForAtlasReady: captureWorld.cjs awaits window.atlasReady === true alongside __chunksReady and groundTextures.ready
